title: Machine-Learning-Guided Design of Soy Protein Isolate Film Mechanics.
summary: Prospective tests probe pH/temperature coupling in soy-protein films; acidic and hot conditions reduce predictive accuracy. Random-fold scores are not prospective performance.
ai_technology: Extra Trees, random forest and gradient boosting regressors
